intent: Show that most Americans need a car to get to work, making transportation the second-largest share of household expenditures in 2019, behind housing.

requirements.question: How does transportation compare with the largest category?

units.claim: Transportation is the second-largest expenditure share at 17%, behind Housing at 33%.
accept: Transportation is second at 17%, behind Housing at 33%
units.evidence: Housing is the longest bar and Transportation the second-longest.

optional_valid: The other categories: Food 12%, Personal insurance 11%, Health care 9%, Clothes 3%
